title: A whole-suite run the sync gate makes for a landing applies the darwin seconds ceiling, so a test that pushes the suite over it is refused at its landing
goal: SP-5x5ut5ko retrospective: ST-wjm2ipaf landed a sync e2e test that took the full suite from 14 s to 23 s on darwin, over the 20 s ceiling; its landing's gate ran tests.py --changed (the whole suite) and passed, because tests.py checks the seconds only in mode full (tests.py:904), and the overrun was found only by the review story's tests.py check (BG-fay4tani). A landing whose gate runs the whole suite refuses a run over the seconds ceiling, or names it.
notes: SP-5i4itd2d close (2026-10-10): after ST-2bly3tq5 added a test id (87 ids) the whole suite ran 19.97 s once (over the 20 s darwin ceiling, refused) and 18.89 s once; each landing's gate passed.
